senses.gloss: הִשְׁחִיר (denom. of שַׁחַר) to be early in doing; to get up early.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>, beg. <he>מי שמַשְׁחִיר וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P01244"><he>עָרַב</he> II</cite>. Midr. Sam. ch. V <he>ע״י שה׳ והעריב בהן</he> because he was engaged in their study early and late; a. e.

senses.gloss: (b. h.) same, to do a thing early or diligently.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:1">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 13:24">Prov. XIII, 24</cite>) <he>לפי ששִׁחֲרוֹ מוסר וכ׳</he> because he corrected him betimes (or earnestly), he loved him.
<cite ref="Proverbs 13:24">Ib.</cite> <he>היה יצחק מְשַׁחֵר מוסר ליעקב וכ׳</he> Isaac trained Jacob &c.
